faction.data_source: 40kdc-data 1.4.5 (11th edition) + Wahapedia 11e codex import 2026-10-16 (Codex: Orks, Codex: Adeptus Custodes)

abilities.name: Waaagh!
abilities.description:
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can:
• Re-roll advance rolls.
• Become riled up, as stated in other rules.
While a unit is riled up:
• That unit has 5+ InSv.
• That unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
• When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.

abilities.name: Support
abilities.description:
SUPPORT24.34
Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.
Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it.
Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

abilities.name: Clever Know-wotz
abilities.description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly Orks Vehicle model (excluding AIRCRAFT/TITANIC models) within 3" of this model:
• That VEHICLE model heals D3 wounds.
• That VEHICLE model's attacks have +1 to hit rolls until the start of your next Movement phase.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-10 Wounds Remaining
abilities.description:
DAMAGED24.39
This ability always takes the form Damaged X. While a model's remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged: while damaged, that model's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise 2D6
abilities.description:
Before this model is removed from play:
  -> Roll one D6: on a 6+, each enemy unit within 6" suffers 2D6 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Super-heavy Walker
abilities.description: Until the end of the turn, this model can move over terrain features 4" or lower (up to 4" high) as though they were not there (excluding Titanic models), during its Normal, Advance and Fall Back moves.

abilities.name: Idol of Belligerence
abilities.description: In your Movement phase, when a unit embarked within this unit is selected to make a disembark move, that unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Waaagh! Effigy
abilities.description: This unit is riled up.

abilities.name: TRANSPORT
abilities.description: This model has a transport capacity of 22 ORKS INFANTRY models. Each MEGA ARMOUR model takes up the space of 2 models. Each JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 models. Each GHAZGHKULL THRAKA model takes up the space of 4 models.
